Коллаген.about: Structural protein: skin, joints, bones. Peptides are absorbed.
Коллаген.caution: Hydrolyzed collagen 2.5-10 g/day, 8-24 weeks. The effect on the skin is significant, but the quality of RCT is often low (high risk of bias). For joints (OA): data are conflicting. Safe, no serious side effects. Optimally: hydrolyzate or peptides (not native collagen).
Коллаген.food_sources: Bone broth, animal skin, gelatin; additives = hydrolyzate (peptides).
forms: hydrolyzate or peptides are not “edible gelatin”; type I/III - skin
Коллаген.guidelines: EFSA: claims not approved; series MA - moderate effect on the skin and joints.
Коллаген.how_to_choose: Hydrolyzate (peptides), not gelatin; types I+III (skin), II (joints); with vitamin C.
mechs: Elasticity of skin, joints under load
Saturation of the dermis with peptides: hydration, elasticity, wrinkles
Skin: elasticity, hydration, wrinkle depth better (RCT 1125 and 805 people)
Substrate for healing: density and renewal of the dermis
Wound healing and dermal density: positive, preliminary data
Коллаген.myths: “Gelatin is equivalent” - peptides are absorbed better. “Works immediately” - 8-12 weeks minimum.
